pages.note: The original Pali itself has one contracted path line for the eight path factors. Retain the translator path list on that same single Pali line; separately split the five preparatory qualities because original Pali57-61 provides each its own key. Ordinals and concluding uddana are untranslated.

The saved source title uses six individual discourse numbers where current Pali expands the second-jhana-through-arahant series. Its last two blocks substitute ingratitude for Dhamma stinginess and belong to264/265-271, not256 or257-263. Collapsed-target expansion alone cannot resolve the numerical mismatch. All source words can be correlated only if this exact target set is made available; the same source duplicates the canonical257-263/264/265-271 pages, so select one source per current document before preserving/publishing its wording. Do not write legacy second-jhana/ingratitude text onto first-jhana256 to consume words. Prefer the existing canonical sources for overlapping documents unless a deliberate edition replacement is approved.
